title: Verify Time Clock user can clock in and clock out
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Time Clock role. (this role is limited to clock in/out).
steps:
1. Locate the clock control in the top bar.
  2. Click Clock In.
  3. Click Clock Out.
expected: Both actions succeed: the user clocks in, the status shows as clocked in, and then clocks out successfully.
